title: Long-Standing Policyholder Deductible Reduction for Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage
content:
Cardinal Mutual reduces the deductible on Cardinal Physical Damage Coverage claims for long-standing policyholders, measured by the inception date of the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy the vehicle is scheduled on.

**Terms.** Where the auto policy's inception date is at least 120 whole months before the loss date, 100 is subtracted; where it is at least 60 but fewer than 120 whole months before the loss date, 50 is subtracted; otherwise nothing is subtracted. The reduction is subtracted from the capped deductible (the option deductible after the package cap on it), and the deductible after the reduction never goes below zero.

Whole months are complete calendar months from the inception date to the loss date. The inception date is read from the Cardinal Personal Auto Policy record; the loss date from the claim's loss report.

## Reduction by tenure

| Whole months from inception to the loss date | Amount subtracted (USD) |
|---|---|
| 120 or more | 100 |
| 60 to 119 | 50 |
| Fewer than 60 | 0 |

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates and figures)

- Inception on the 15th of a month; loss exactly 120 whole months later on the 15th: 100 is subtracted. Loss on the 14th, one day earlier: 119 whole months, so 50 is subtracted.
- Loss exactly 60 whole months after inception: 50 is subtracted. At 59 whole months: nothing.
- Capped deductible 500 with 100 subtracted: 400. Capped deductible 0 (a glass repair) with 100 subtracted: the result stays at 0, never below zero.
